name: Lands of Fury
description:
About This Game

You crash at the base of a Metra mountain that does not let you climb it quietly. Your goal is at the peak.

Each run takes you through a mix of explorable areas, tight paths, and brutal arena fights. One moment you’re scouting ahead and choosing your route — the next you’re locked in, surrounded, and forced to fight your way out.

Shape your play-style through the gear you find and the combinations you create — from controlled, precise combat to overwhelming, screen-filling destruction.

Fight alongside companions you can actively command, turning every encounter into a mix of action and control.

You don’t pick a class. You build one.

THE CLIMB

A run-based ascent where death sends you back stronger, not back to zero.

  • Camp — set your skill tree, recruit companions, prepare for the climb.

  • Climb — push through biomes, explore, gather, craft, and fight.

  • Fall — lose your gear, but keep your meta tokens and unlocked skills.

  • Return — invest your progress at camp and climb again, better than before.

COMBAT

Your build defines how you fight.

  • Combine runes and items to create devastating interactions.

  • Build up your Fury in battle — then unleash massive rune-based attacks.

  • Chain reactions that turn simple attacks into explosive combos.

FIGHT TOGETHER. TAKE CONTROL.

You don’t fight alone — and now, you can bring a friend into the fight.

Before each run, choose one companion to join you. Each companion has a distinct role, abilities, and playstyle, giving you a different way to approach combat.

In shared-screen co-op, your friend can take control of that companion and fight alongside you.

Play together on the same screen — either side-by-side or online through Steam Remote Play Together. You control your main character. Your friend controls your companion. Two players, one deadly team.

Coordinate attacks, combine your abilities, control space, and turn your companion's unique strengths into powerful team plays.

  • Take one companion with you on each run.

  • Coordinate attacks and combine your abilities.

  • Play shared-screen co-op with a friend.

  • Use Steam Remote Play Together to play online.

  • You stay in control of your main character.

  • Your friend can take control of your companion.

  • Play solo and command your companion — or let them fight independently.

BUILD

Set the foundation of your build before the climb — then shape it as you fight, earning rewards from each run to unlock new skills (cartridges) and be better prepared for the next ascent. 

CRAFT

Gather ingredients, and craft powerful items to enhance your combat.

REPLAYABILITY & CHALLENGE

The mountain changes, you evolve.

  • Explore the forests, caverns and frozen peaks.

  • Procedurally generated levels make every run unique.

  • Battle bandits, ratfolk, undead, dinofolk, golems, and more.

  • Survive challenging battles against powerful bosses.

  • Unlock new items, skills and companions.

  • Compete in daily runs to earn your place on the leaderboards.

Only fury will carry you to the peak.
short_desc: Fight your way up a brutal mountain. Combine weapons, cartridges, runes, and companions to create devastating combat builds and carve through relentless enemies in this combat-driven roguelite ARPG.
